note: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only dictionary-based variable assignments. It defines no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used as a base config to instantiate a BiSeNetV1 (ResNet-18 backbone, 32-channel output) EncoderDecoder model for semantic segmentation with 19 classes.
summarize_model_config: summarize the BiSeNetV1 ResNet-18 EncoderDecoder model configuration for 19-class semantic segmentation
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration used across the BiSeNetV1 model
review_backbone_cfg: review the ResNet-18 backbone configuration with 4 stages and pytorch style
review_decode_head: review the FCNHead decode head configuration with 256 channels and 0.1 dropout
review_auxiliary_heads: review the two FCNHead auxiliary heads configuration for multi-scale training
